name: BCL11 transcription factor B
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: BCL11B encodes b-cell lymphoma/leukemia 11B. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and hematopoietic stem cell migration.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual developmental disorder with speech delay, dysmorphic facies, and t-cell abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia; T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
